name: GPU Screen-Space Ray Tracing via DDA
aliases: Efficient GPU Screen-Space Ray Tracing via DDA
definition: A GPU-optimized screen-space ray tracing method that adapts the perspective-correct Digital Differential Analyzer (DDA) line rasterization algorithm to trace rays against a depth buffer. It ensures sampling at a contiguous set of pixels with no oversampling, addressing the inefficiency and missing intersections of linear 3D marching.
